question: Should maintainers allow this exact-head retry job to run the autonomous merge path for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101062?
rationale: The diff is structurally consistent and narrow, but merging it deliberately enables a repository automation mutation outside this PR, so a maintainer should own the live head/check/policy acceptance.

options.title: Merge the retry job
options.body: Merge once the OpenClaw target still matches b4d79c8512511a2474d9d31b1826e332c6c660c0 and current checks/policy are unchanged; the queued run will revalidate by exact-head preflight before applying a merge.

options.title: Regenerate for drift
options.body: If the target head or relevant evidence changed, regenerate the queue file with the new exact head and fresh evidence.

options.title: Pause the merge wave
options.body: If maintainers no longer want the automated merge, leave this PR unmerged or close it without dispatching the job.

recommendation.title: Merge the retry job
